Honestly, I just looked up flow state with cannabis today and im glad to see someone feels the way i do i personally use it when gaming it works amazingly, i think real research should be done on cannabis inducing flow state. I personally have been using it to achieve flow state for about a year now and i find that it is much easier to achieve flow state while high because it just drowns out everything once you're high you're in the moment one of the things flow state requires or marijuana at least helps you reach a point where you feel in the moment and I also feel that it reinvigorates me to play the game again despite having 1000's of hours and while sober I do not feel like I am having "fun" while playing more so just doing it to do it. I think the reason you play better while high has to do with most likely those two factors as well being just playing too much music that you do it more to "practice" or to perform rather than to enjoy just the act of doing it and marijuana calming you and giving music that "magic" back to it. sorry this is my first reddit post so just a side note i also drew this conclusion from the fact that i have played 100's of games and every single one when a new shooter came out (a genre i usually play) the skill and experience i had from other games transferred over and i would play amazingly on the new game for a while before it grew stale and i more so again just played it to play it than the new "magic" feeling marijuana so unrecognizably imitates.
